XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Gearbox fault warning light flashing. The gearbox remains in neutral (N) position.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | LOCKED | GEAR | p2915 | p2913 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicles equipped with Selespeed gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Gear selection/engagement actuator.

  • Fault: The robotised gearbox is stuck in neutral (N), accompanied by the automatic gearbox fault warning light flashing. The instrument panel indicates that the gearbox should be checked and the manual consulted.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P2913, P2915

  • Cause: Fault in the robotised gearbox actuator

• Action: Check and, if necessary, correct the following items:
    - Oil level in the gearbox, replacing it if necessary.
    - Functionality of the gear shift actuator.
    - Oil level in the electro-hydraulic gearbox robotisation unit.

    In this case, it was necessary to replace the robotised gearbox actuator.
